items.title: Camden Property Trust (CPT) Stock Looks Cheap Against Future Cash Flow
items.summary: Camden Property Trust has seen its share price under pressure recently, and the stock closed at US$97.41 after a run of weaker returns. That slide puts the focus squarely on a bigger question for investors in Camden Property Trust, which is whether the current price is properly supported by the cash flows the business can generate over time. items.summary: US 30 year mortgage rates just moved back above 7%, and that kind of jump in borrowing costs can quickly reshape where Americans choose to live and rent.
